title: Term Life Insurance Back Installments: Fee Share for Owners of Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance
content:
**Relationship terms — Term Life Insurance.** In the back installment billed for reinstatement, the policy fee share follows the owner's other Ashgrove life policies, read from the owner's Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance policy records:

| The owner holds, in force | Fee share charged |
|---|---|
| an Ashgrove whole life policy and an Ashgrove universal life policy | nothing |
| exactly one of the two | one half (0.5) |
| neither | the whole fee |

A policy counts only while its status is in force. Hypothetical: a fee of 55.00 before the share is charged at 27.50 to an owner holding only an in-force Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth.
